title: Mycophenolate vs Azathioprin in Autoimmune Hepatitis
brief_summary: A study with 20 de novo patients with autoimmune hepatitis, 10 receiving azathioprin and 10 receiving mycophenolat mofetil.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* De novo autoimmune hepatitis
* Consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* age below 18
* pregnancy
